content: सेना [सि-न, सह इनेन प्रभुणा वा; <ls>Uṇ. 3. 10</ls>] .²1 An army; सेना परिच्छदस्तस्य द्वयमेवार्थसाधनम् <ls>R. 1. 19</ls>. .²2 Army personified as the wife of Kārtikeya, the god of war; <ab>cf.</ab> देवसेना. .²3 A small army (consisting of 3 elephants, 3 chariots, 9 horse and 15 foot). .²4 Any body of men.
